changelog:
CSM 1.0.880

Episode badges: now two pills, like you asked

• Each supported poster shows a small pill pair at the bottom right: a purple
  pill with the total episodes released and a blue pill with the number of
  episodes you have actually watched (for example "24 Ep" and "12").
• The pills sit immediately to the LEFT of the dub/audio label so that label
  stays visible; where a card has no dub label they fall back to the bottom-right
  corner.
• Styling is CSM's own: fully rounded, one line, white numerals, tight spacing.
  Purple means total and blue means watched, the same way CSM's score and quality
  badges carry meaning, so those two colours stay fixed and are not taken from
  your palette.
• Only real numbers are shown. "Watched" means the episode is genuinely marked
  as watched in CloudStream; an episode you merely started does not count, and
  progress, quality or title text is never used as a count. A genuine zero is
  shown as zero, while an unknown value shows no pill at all instead of a
  placeholder.
• A card that has only a total shows only the purple pill. On the result page's
  hero poster and in the home preview carousel only the total can be shown,
  because those surfaces carry no provider/URL identity to look a watch count up
  for - so nothing is guessed there.
• The watched count appears a moment after the total, because the two lookups run
  one after the other to stay gentle on providers.
• The setting still explains that this may load a series once to learn its numbers
  and that it uses extra data. It stays off by default.

Notifications

• The placeholder notifications stay removed; only real announcements are shown,
  the preview no longer invents a card, and the fresh feed source is requested
  before the cached mirror.

Under the hood

• The watched count is read from CloudStream's own per-episode watch state, so it
  matches the checkmarks the app itself shows. If that state cannot be read, the
  blue pill is simply omitted.
